title: News Reflection: President Marcos could not keep his guest waiting
summary: US President Donald Trump received two welcomes in Manila: festivities on the tarmac and protests on the streets.

blocks.text: Although US President Donald Trump almost missed the ASEAN Summit in Manila — he must have had other priorities — Philippine President Bongbong Marcos spared no minute, no time for one more question, to welcome him.

Trump arrived in Manila to the usual festive welcome Filipinos afford guests — on the tarmac. But on the streets near the summit venue, the Philippine International Convention Center in Pasay City, protesters rallied to express their disagreement with Trump’s policies, specifically his government’s planned establishment of Pax Silica data centers in Central Luzon.

When a reporter tried to ask Marcos about these protests, his press relations chief was quick to point out that he had more important matters to attend to. Both palms raised, he apologized, ending his briefing abruptly — he couldn’t keep the POTUS waiting.
This week’s News Reflection, from Paterno Esmaquel II. – Rappler.com
